nodes.label: dgrid_dshot
nodes.rationale: Extend slot 0xC in place rather than creating a new slot because the address map has no free slot without touching frozen decoder logic, RX/TX are mutually exclusive on same pads so one owner is safer, and timing registers can be shared.

nodes.label: dgrid_dshot_tel
nodes.rationale: Firmware supplies only exponent and mantissa {e, m}; hardware performs CRC, GCR, and transition encoding to limit firmware overhead to one register write per commutation update.

nodes.label: dgrid_irq
nodes.rationale: Allocates previously unused bit 7 in raw interrupt vector with dshot_rx_i defaulted to 1'b0 to avoid disturbing the frozen lite netlist.

nodes.label: openframe_project_wrapper

nodes.label: DGridRiscV Core (rv32imc Lockstep)
nodes.rationale: CPU has a hardwired PMA whitelist requiring addr[31] set or 0x1xxx_xxxx, which is why SRAM is at 0x9 and peripherals are at 0xC/0xD.

nodes.label: DMA Controller
nodes.rationale: The top arbitrates LSU-priority over DMA.

nodes.label: CPU PMA Whitelist
nodes.rationale: A load or store is legal only if addr[31] is set or the address is in 0x1xxx_xxxx; that is why SRAM is mapped at 0x9000_0000 and peripherals at 0xC/0xD/0xE.

nodes.label: 64-pin QFN Package (SkyWater sky130A)
nodes.rationale: Pinout shared between DG32-LITE and DG32-2DOM because attention engine is memory-mapped internally and adds no user pads.

nodes.label: INT8 Attention Accelerator
nodes.rationale: Computes band of query rows of one head end to end (QK^T, softmax/EXP, E.V, requantise to int8) with shared LANES-wide MAC array, 256-entry u15 EXP table, and 40-bit numerator on clk_fast_i (114 MHz).

nodes.label: 64 KB Boot ROM
nodes.rationale: Standalone boot without management core: emits banner on UART0, reads QSPI NOR flash header, copies image to SRAM via quad-output fast-read, jumps to SRAM.

nodes.label: CORDIC Coprocessor
nodes.rationale: Q1.31 rotation and vectoring coprocessor (N=20 iterations, 53-58 cycles) at 0xDE00_0000; magnitude is uncompensated by design.

nodes.label: Dual RV32IMC Lockstep Core
nodes.rationale: Dual lockstep core running at 50 MHz design target on sky130A process with hardwired PMA whitelist.

nodes.label: DShot ESC Engine
nodes.rationale: ESC engine at 0xC000_0000 pin-muxed onto PWM pads with 4 throttle channels sharing one bit-time counter.

nodes.label: Fault CSR
nodes.rationale: Lockstep fault status and injection module at 0xD600_0000; sticky-first recording of mismatch causes.

nodes.label: IRQ Aggregator
nodes.rationale: Aggregates 16 interrupt sources (including timers, PWM trigger, ADC done, DMA, fault, SW, and ATTN) at 0xDF00_0000.

nodes.label: 3-Phase PWM

nodes.label: SAR ADC

nodes.label: 32 KB SRAM
nodes.rationale: Main data and code execution memory at 0x9000_0000, required because CPU fetch bus is ROM-only and cannot execute directly from QSPI-XIP.

nodes.label: Supervisor / wWDT
nodes.rationale: Windowed watchdog and rail monitor at 0xD700_0000; faults if kicked before WDTMIN or after WDTMAX.

nodes.label: Fault CSR Block
nodes.rationale: Maintains sticky fault status and lockstep-compare mismatch events (base 0xD600_0000)
